# Founder AI Stack 2026 — Horixon

Pick one tool per job. Start free, upgrade only when the job is daily.

| Job | What to look for | Starter pick (free tier) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thinking & writing | Strong reasoning, long context | A general assistant (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini) | Use one; learn it deeply |
| Building product | Coding agent in your IDE / terminal | AI coding agent | Pair with tests |
| Prototyping UI | Prompt → working app | AI app builder | Throw away, then rebuild |
| Research | Cited answers, web access | AI search / deep research | Verify sources |
| Sales | Lead lists + personalised outreach | AI prospecting tool | Keep volume human-scale |
| Support | Answers from your docs | AI support assistant | Hand-off to human |
| Meetings | Notes + action items | AI note taker | Get consent |
| Ops & automation | Connect apps, run agents | Workflow automation tool | Start with 1 workflow |
| Content | Video / image / voice | AI media tools | Check usage rights |
| Data | Ask questions of your data | AI analytics / SQL assistant | Read-only access |

## Monthly review (15 minutes)
- Which tool did we use every week? Keep.
- Which did we pay for and not use? Cancel.
- What new launch on Horixon could replace two tools? Pilot it with the scorecard.

*Fill this in with the tools you choose. Updated picks every week in the Horixon Weekly.*
